description: Defines functions, classes, enums, and structures for verifying certificate chains, including delegate interfaces, verification parameters, and error handling, used in TLS/SSL certificate validation.

classes.name: VerifyCertificateChainDelegate
classes.description: Interface for delegate methods used during certificate chain verification, including signature algorithm and public key acceptance, and verification cache retrieval.

methods.name: VerifyCertificateChain
methods.description: Verifies an ordered chain of DER-encoded certificates against trust and policy parameters, checking for validity, trustworthiness, and policy constraints.

methods.name: VerifyCertificateIsSelfSigned
methods.description: Checks if a given certificate is self-signed, optionally using a cache, and reports errors if any.
